title: Rate Administration Proration Clause: Partial-Year Seasonal Minimum on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Irrigation Accounts
content:
**Clause.** The seasonal minimum of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule irrigation account guarantees a portion of the year set by how long the account has been connected and how long its current rate schedule has been in effect, both read from the service account record.

| Account record | Portion of the year guaranteed |
|---|---|
| Connected less than twelve whole months before the current date | The whole months elapsed since the connect date, divided by twelve |
| Connected twelve whole months or more, and the current rate schedule took effect less than twelve whole months before the current date, on a date later than the connect date | The whole months elapsed since that rate effective date, divided by twelve |
| Any other account | The full twelve months |

The portion multiplies the guaranteed minimum before it is rounded: the guaranteed minimum is the minimum rate per kVA multiplied by the kVA measure and by the portion, the product rounded once to the cent.

### Hypothetical cases ($22.80 per kVA on a 200 kVA measure)

| Account | Portion | Guaranteed minimum |
|---|---|---|
| Connected 7 whole months ago | 7 twelfths | $2,660.00 |
| Connected 5 years ago, moved onto Schedule IR 9 whole months ago | 9 twelfths | $3,420.00 |
| Connected 5 years ago, on Schedule IR since connection | The full year | $4,560.00 |

### Point of reading

- A rate effective date equal to the connect date does not reduce the portion; only a later rate effective date does.
